title: Reliability of Hammersmith Examination in Prediction of Neurological Outcomes (REHAPENO)
brief_summary: In this study workers are trying to test the correlation between Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination and MRI brain/cranial ultrasound with early prediction of neurological developmental outcome of preterm neonates. This study is prospective cross-sectional collecting the data of patients according to daily standard medical practice
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Preterm infants \<37 weeks' GA at birth admitted to the neonatal nurseries at the Abha Private Hospital in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This project aims to recruit 50 infants \<37weeks at birth over a 1-year stating from march 2018

Exclusion Criteria:

* -infants with congenital or chromosomal abnormalities
